name: Get Me Out of Here!
summary: In the Valley of Spears, Melizza Brimbuzzle fears the Maraudines mean to eat her. She asks you to get her out, and her brother Hornizz promises good pay.

sections.title: Trouble in the Valley
sections.body: Melizza Brimbuzzle came to the Valley of Spears hoping to strike a deal with the Maraudines. They would not talk, and now she fears they mean to eat her. Minutes ago, she overheard centaurs discussing wood for their cookpot. She wants to leave quickly.

sections.title: Her Brother's Camp
sections.body: Hornizz Brimbuzzle waits at the family camp east of Melizza's present position. It lies beside the kodo graveyard. Melizza promises her brother will pay you well if you bring her out of the valley.

sections.title: Back at the Camp
sections.body: Hornizz says Melizza told him you were coming. He thanks you for getting her out of trouble, then guesses she has already found herself another. Melizza hurries ahead and says the Maraudines are too hard to work with. She heads for the Gelkis, whom she calls more reasonable.

faq.q: Why is Melizza Brimbuzzle in trouble?
faq.answer: Melizza went to the Valley of Spears hoping to do business with the Maraudines. They would not talk, and she fears they mean to eat her.
The Maraudines are centaurs of Desolace. Melizza went to the Valley of Spears hoping to do business with them.
Hornizz Brimbuzzle waits at the Brimbuzzles' camp in Desolace, beside the Kodo Graveyard and east of Melizza's present position.

faq.q: Why does Melizza say her brother will pay you?
faq.answer: Melizza promises her brother Hornizz will pay you well if you get her out of the valley.
